pages.text: Hypernet is used for the production and distribution of computing power (unit: TFloPs, trillion floating-point operations per second). Computing power is used to unlock technologies and maintain the operation of advanced machines.

The key card is used to connect devices to the network.$(br)Right-click the Network Center Controller to store the configuration, then right-click other machines to connect. After connecting, the configuration in the card will not be cleared.$(br)Usually each person can get two key cards: one to put into the Research Terminal, and one for device connection.$(br)The second key card is obtained from the quest book after acquiring the Network Center.

The Network Center is used to create a Hypernet. Each network is limited to one.$(br)Different tiers of Network Centers provide different bandwidth limits and connection limits:$(br)Bandwidth limit: $(a)400T (Tier 1) $(9)5P (Tier 2) $(d)700P (Tier 3)$(br)$()Connection limit: $(a)30 (Tier 1) $(9)90 (Tier 2)$(br)$(d)180 (Tier 3)

The Network Center has durability. When it is depleted, it cannot operate and needs to be repaired with the above three circuits.$(br)$(e)Only circuits of a tier less than or equal to the Network Center's tier can be used.$(br)$(a)+1000 durability (Tier 1)$(br)$(9)+4000 durability (Tier 2)$(br)$(6)+150000 durability (Tier 3)
